title: Stated reading debts: the sources a claim owes before it hardens
description: These claims name the sources owed before a claim is stated in final form: Russell, Mazzucchi, Halliwell and Ellis for the sixth erratum (#1474), Ross and Dorion for Nothing Before Us (#1603), the MEGA² II/6 apparatus for Monetary Dark Matter (#1631), the Clouds read rather than counted for the authorship notebook (#1569), and the open verification items in The Noun Becomes a Verb and The Colony Enters the Factory (#1668, #1669). Nearby claims state falsifiers and open edges: #1543 revises its falsifier for generative uptake, #944 claims the Mandala inscription book's open write path as an exposed edge, #1538 argues that Zenodo's observed out-of-scope reason excludes a default invocation of its moderation path, and #3 and #1637 name what their measures miss. The page also holds unrelated claims on Arendt's natality and vpcor.org.

claims.statement: Natality: the capacity to begin something new. Against Heidegger's being-toward-death, Arendt posits being-toward-birth. The feminine principle smuggled into political ontology without naming it as such. Arendt refused the label "feminist." The void: the thinker who most profoundly theorized natality — beginning, birth, the aperture through which the new enters the world — refused to occupy the category her thinking most deeply serves.

claims.statement: Still outstanding: **Russell 1964** (in copyright) for the modern metrical objection in its own terms; **Mazzucchi**; **Halliwell 2022**; and **Robinson Ellis, *Hermathena* XXII.385**, cited by Roberts as "another view" and not yet read. None of these is now blocking on the attribution question, which the nineteenth century already contested in print. **The remaining blocker is narrower: whether any editor has argued that the words are Longinus's AND belong to the poem** — the position of §II-ter, which the sources consulted do not record anyone holding.
